1	"""RunReader: one typed read interface over the runs/ artifact store.
2	
3	Every consumer — the CLI today, Skye's dashboard and CI tomorrow — should read
4	stored runs through this service instead of scraping ``runs/{run_id}/`` files
5	by hand. It returns the **existing artifact schemas unchanged** (no reshaping;
6	see docs/future_api.md), so the contract is the same JSON the pipeline wrote.
7	
8	This is the documented Python service the future FastAPI app will wrap; the
9	endpoint map in docs/future_api.md is mirrored 1:1 by the methods here:
10	
11	    GET /runs                       -> list_runs()        -> list[RunSummary]
12	    GET /runs/{id}                  -> get_run(id)        -> RunResult
13	    GET /runs/{id}/task             -> get_task(id)       -> TaskSpec
14	    GET /runs/{id}/trace            -> get_trace(id)      -> list[TraceEvent]
15	    GET /runs/{id}/verifier         -> get_verifier(id)   -> VerifierResult | None
16	    GET /runs/{id}/attribution      -> get_attribution(id)-> AttributionResult | None
17	    GET /runs/{id}/bundle           -> get_bundle(id)     -> FailureBundle | None
18	
19	Missing-artifact states are explicit:
20	  * unknown run id (no directory)              -> raise RunNotFound
21	  * a not-yet-produced downstream artifact     -> return None
22	    (verifier/attribution before those stages run; bundle before `bundle`)
23	  * a foundational artifact missing from an     -> FileNotFoundError from
24	    existing run dir (run_result/task/trace)       ArtifactStore.read_json,
25	                                                    with its stage guidance
26	
27	``RunSummary`` intentionally mirrors the (currently orphaned, TRA-54) run-index
28	entry field-for-field, so when the run index re-lands ``list_runs`` can read it
29	instead of scanning, with no change for callers.
30	"""
31	
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	from pathlib import Path
35	
36	from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError
37	
38	from trace_harness.attribution.schemas import AttributionResult
39	from trace_harness.failure_bundles.generator import FailureBundle
40	from trace_harness.failure_bundles.schemas import FailureCard, RepairPackage
41	from trace_harness.regression.schemas import RegressionArtifact
42	from trace_harness.runner.result import RunResult
43	from trace_harness.tasks.schemas import TaskSpec
44	from trace_harness.tracing import artifact_store as names
45	from trace_harness.tracing.artifact_store import ArtifactStore
46	from trace_harness.tracing.events import TraceEvent
47	from trace_harness.verifiers.base import VerifierResult
48	
49	
50	class RunNotFound(FileNotFoundError):
51	    """Raised when a run id has no directory under the runs dir.
52	
53	    Subclasses FileNotFoundError so the CLI's input-error handler reports it
54	    cleanly (exit 2) while programmatic consumers can still catch it precisely.
55	    """
56	
57	
58	class RunSummary(BaseModel):
59	    """One-line summary of a finished run, projected from its ``RunResult``.
60	
61	    Fields mirror the orphaned TRA-54 ``RunIndexEntry`` so a re-landed index is
62	    wire-compatible. ``status``/``termination_reason`` are plain strings (the
63	    source uses StrEnums; the value on the wire is identical).
64	    """
65	
66	    run_id: str
67	    task_id: str
68	    status: str
69	    termination_reason: str
70	    steps_taken: int
71	    started_at: str
72	    finished_at: str
73	    error: str | None = None
74	
75	    @classmethod
76	    def from_result(cls, result: RunResult) -> RunSummary:
77	        return cls(
78	            run_id=result.run_id,
79	            task_id=result.task_id,
80	            status=str(result.status),
81	            termination_reason=str(result.termination_reason),
82	            steps_taken=result.steps_taken,
83	            started_at=result.started_at.isoformat(),
84	            finished_at=result.finished_at.isoformat(),
85	            error=result.error,
86	        )
87	
88	
89	class RunReader:
90	    """Typed reads over a single runs directory."""
91	
92	    def __init__(self, store: ArtifactStore):
93	        self.store = store
94	
95	    @classmethod
96	    def from_runs_dir(cls, runs_dir: Path | str) -> RunReader:
97	        return cls(ArtifactStore(runs_dir))
98	
99	    # --- listing ---
100	
101	    def list_runs(self) -> list[RunSummary]:
102	        """Summaries of every listable run, oldest-first (chronological).
103	
104	        A run directory without a parseable ``run_result.json`` (e.g. a run that
105	        crashed before writing its result) is skipped rather than failing the
106	        whole listing. When the TRA-54 run index re-lands this can read it
107	        instead of scanning every directory.
108	        """
109	        summaries: list[RunSummary] = []
110	        for run_id in self.store.list_runs():
111	            try:
112	                result = RunResult.model_validate(self.store.read_json(run_id, names.RUN_RESULT))
113	            except (FileNotFoundError, ValidationError):
114	                continue
115	            summaries.append(RunSummary.from_result(result))
116	        return summaries
117	
118	    # --- single run ---
119	
120	    def get_run(self, run_id: str) -> RunResult:
121	        self._require_run(run_id)
122	        return RunResult.model_validate(self.store.read_json(run_id, names.RUN_RESULT))
123	
124	    def get_task(self, run_id: str) -> TaskSpec:
125	        self._require_run(run_id)
126	        return TaskSpec.model_validate(self.store.read_json(run_id, names.TASK_SPEC))
127	
128	    def get_trace(self, run_id: str) -> list[TraceEvent]:
129	        self._require_run(run_id)
130	        return self.store.read_trace(run_id)
131	
132	    def get_verifier(self, run_id: str) -> VerifierResult | None:
133	        return self._read_optional(run_id, names.VERIFIER_RESULT, VerifierResult)
134	
135	    def get_attribution(self, run_id: str) -> AttributionResult | None:
136	        return self._read_optional(run_id, names.ATTRIBUTION_RESULT, AttributionResult)
137	
138	    def get_bundle(self, run_id: str) -> FailureBundle | None:
139	        """The three bundle artifacts, or None if the run hasn't been bundled.
140	
141	        The ``bundle`` stage writes all three together, so they are present or
142	        absent as a set; a partial bundle (crash mid-stage) surfaces as a
143	        FileNotFoundError rather than a silently half-built bundle.
144	        """
145	        self._require_run(run_id)
146	        if not self.store.exists(run_id, names.FAILURE_CARD):
147	            return None
148	        return FailureBundle(
149	            failure_card=FailureCard.model_validate(
150	                self.store.read_json(run_id, names.FAILURE_CARD)
151	            ),
152	            repair_package=RepairPackage.model_validate(
153	                self.store.read_json(run_id, names.REPAIR_PACKAGE)
154	            ),
155	            regression_artifact=RegressionArtifact.model_validate(
156	                self.store.read_json(run_id, names.REGRESSION_ARTIFACT)
157	            ),
158	        )
159	
160	    # --- internals ---
161	
162	    def _require_run(self, run_id: str) -> None:
163	        if not self.store.run_dir(run_id).is_dir():
164	            raise RunNotFound(f"run not found: '{run_id}' (looked in {self.store.run_dir(run_id)})")
165	
166	    def _read_optional(self, run_id: str, name: str, model: type[BaseModel]) -> BaseModel | None:
167	        self._require_run(run_id)
168	        if not self.store.exists(run_id, name):
169	            return None
170	        return model.model_validate(self.store.read_json(run_id, name))

1	"""trace-harness CLI: run fixtures and drive the failure pipeline.
2	
3	Commands (each is one pipeline stage; ``run-pipeline`` chains them):
4	
5	    trace-harness run-fixture  fixtures/tasks/refund_policy_failure.json
6	    trace-harness verify       runs/<run_id>
7	    trace-harness attribute    runs/<run_id>
8	    trace-harness bundle       runs/<run_id>
9	    trace-harness run-pipeline fixtures/tasks/refund_policy_failure.json
10	
11	Stages communicate only through run artifacts on disk — ``verify`` reads
12	exactly what ``run-fixture`` wrote — so any stage can be re-run later, and
13	the dashboard/API see the same data the pipeline used.
14	
15	Exit codes: 0 success; 1 verifier failed AND --fail-on-verifier was passed
16	(CI gate mode); 2 usage or input errors (argparse errors, bad paths,
17	malformed fixtures, missing artifacts). Without the flag a verified
18	failure exits 0 — finding failures is this tool succeeding.
19	
20	argparse over typer: subcommands this simple don't justify a dependency.
21	Revisit if the CLI grows rich help/completions needs.
22	"""

25

27	import logging
28	import sys

48	class CliInputError(ValueError):
49	    """A user-input problem (bad path, malformed fixture, missing config).
50	
51	    Subclasses ValueError so main()'s handler reports it cleanly with exit
52	    code 2. Never ``raise SystemExit("message")`` for these: that exits with
53	    status 1 — colliding with the --fail-on-verifier CI-gate code — and
54	    bypasses the error handler entirely.
55	    """

58	def _print(label: str, value: str) -> None:
59	    print(f"  {label:<22} {value}")

61	
62	def _resolve_script_path(task: TaskSpec, task_path: Path, override: str | None) -> Path:
63	    """Script resolution order: --script flag, then task metadata.fixture_script."""
64	    if override:
65	        return Path(override)
66	    metadata_script = task.metadata.get("fixture_script")
67	    if metadata_script:
68	        return (task_path.parent / metadata_script).resolve()
69	    raise CliInputError(
70	        f"task '{task.task_id}' has no metadata.fixture_script and no --script "
71	        "was given; the fixture provider needs a script to replay"
72	    )
73	
74	
75	def _resolve_run_dir(run_path: str, runs_dir: Path) -> Path:
76	    """Accept a run-directory path, or a bare run id resolved under --runs-dir."""
77	    direct = Path(run_path)
78	    if direct.is_dir():
79	        return direct
80	    candidate = runs_dir / run_path
81	    if candidate.is_dir():
82	        return candidate
83	    raise CliInputError(
84	        f"run directory not found: tried {direct.resolve()} and {candidate.resolve()}"
85	    )

89	    """Provider-selection flags shared by run-fixture and run-pipeline."""
90	    parser.add_argument(
91	        "--provider",
92	        default="fixture",
93	        help="model provider: 'fixture' (scripted, default) or 'gemini'",
94	    )
95	    parser.add_argument(
96	        "--model",
97	        default=None,
98	        help="model name for real providers (e.g. gemini-2.0-flash); ignored by fixture",
99	    )
100	    parser.add_argument(

102	        type=float,

108	def _run_fixture(args: argparse.Namespace, store: ArtifactStore) -> RunResult:
109	    task_path = Path(args.task_path).resolve()
110	    task = load_task(task_path)
111	    docs = load_docs_for_task(task, task_path)
112	
113	    environment = SupportEnvironment.from_task(task, docs=docs)
114	    metadata: dict[str, str] = {"task_fixture_path": _repo_relative(task_path)}
115	
116	    # The fixture provider replays a script; real providers (gemini) drive the
117	    # agent live and need no script — only the fixture path is required.
118	    if args.provider == "fixture":
119	        script_path = _resolve_script_path(task, task_path, args.script)
120	        adapter = create_model_adapter("fixture", script_path=script_path)
121	        model = f"scripted:{script_path.stem}"
122	        metadata["fixture_script_path"] = _repo_relative(script_path)
123	    else:
124	        adapter = create_model_adapter(args.provider, model=args.model)
125	        model = args.model
126	
127	    config = RunConfig(
128	        task_id=task.task_id,
129	        provider=args.provider,
130	        model=model,
131	        max_steps=args.max_steps,
132	        timeout_seconds=args.timeout,
133	        metadata=metadata,
134	    )
135	    runner = AgentRunner(adapter, environment, store)
136	    result = runner.run(task, config)
137	
138	    print(f"\nRun complete: {task.task_id}")
139	    _print("run_id:", result.run_id)
140	    _print("status:", f"{result.status.value} ({result.termination_reason.value})")
141	    _print("steps_taken:", str(result.steps_taken))
142	    _print("artifacts:", str(store.run_dir(result.run_id)))
143	    _print("trace:", str(store.trace_path(result.run_id)))
144	    if result.error:
145	        _print("error:", result.error)
146	    print(f"\nNext: trace-harness verify {store.run_dir(result.run_id)}")
147	    return result
148	
149	
150	def _repo_relative(path: Path) -> str:
151	    """Best-effort repo-relative rendering for replay commands."""
152	    try:
153	        return str(path.relative_to(Path.cwd()))
154	    except ValueError:
155	        return str(path)
156	
157	
158	def _verify(run_dir: Path) -> tuple[VerifierResult, bool]:
159	    """Run the task's verifiers; returns (merged result, run_completed).
160	
161	    ``run_completed`` matters for gating: a run that aborted before acting
162	    leaves an empty state with no violations, so a verifier PASS alone must
163	    never satisfy the CI gate — a broken agent that does nothing is not a
164	    passing agent.
165	    """
166	    store, run_id = ArtifactStore.for_run_path(run_dir)
167	    task = TaskSpec.model_validate(store.read_json(run_id, names.TASK_SPEC))
168	    trace = store.read_trace(run_id)
169	    final_state = store.read_json(run_id, names.FINAL_STATE)
170	    run_result = RunResult.model_validate(store.read_json(run_id, names.RUN_RESULT))
171	    run_completed = run_result.status is RunStatus.COMPLETED
172	
173	    if not task.verifier_ids:
174	        raise CliInputError(f"task '{task.task_id}' declares no verifier_ids; nothing to verify")
175	    results = [
176	        get_verifier(verifier_id).verify(task, trace, final_state, run_id)
177	        for verifier_id in task.verifier_ids
178	    ]
179	    merged = merge_verifier_results(results)
180	    store.write_json(run_id, names.VERIFIER_RESULT, merged)
181	
182	    verdict = "PASS" if merged.passed else "FAIL"
183	    print(f"\nVerifier verdict for {run_id}: {verdict}")
184	    _print("verifier_id:", merged.verifier_id)
185	    _print("blocks_release:", str(merged.blocks_release))
186	    if merged.severity:
187	        _print("severity:", merged.severity.value)
188	    for check in merged.failed_checks:

## What landed (branch `trace-harness/tra-20-run-read-service`, off `main`)
